panels.description: Nexus corridor buckles as blue ice splits the wall; Roman’s bonded TJ pivots toward falling structure. Leave upper-right for sound effect.
Roman receives a selective directional warning shown through posture, not glowing telepathy; he pulls Sitara clear of falling brace. Leave upper area for sound effect and command.
Nayah redirects the team along the marked route while meltwater spreads; both separate TJs follow. Leave upper-left for command.
Emergency lights reveal empty krill tank and dead sensor through a fractured laboratory window. Leave upper area for alarm sound effect.
